title: 排桌 Pâi-toh
subject: the bride's mother seating thirty banquet tables around two aunts who have not spoken in twenty years
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien musical-theatre show tune, a book-musical character number. A pit band of piano, string quartet, clarinet and flute obbligatos and acoustic bass, with a drum kit that moves from brushes to sticks, and timpani rolls and orchestral stabs marking each section turn. A rubato piano intro, a driving uptempo middle and a half-step key change into the final chorus. A roomy stage-pit sound, the voice forward and the strings wide. Female lead in a confident Broadway-style chest-mix belt, singing in character, with half-spoken recitative lines in the first verse and the bridge, and a full mixed ensemble entering in harmony on the last chorus. 132 BPM, B flat major rising to B major. Frazzled, bossy and finally triumphant. No pop drum loop, no rock guitar, no Taiwanese opera percussion or singing, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.
lyrics:
[Verse]
三十桌 一桌十个人 紅紙鋪佇桌頂
大姑佮三姑 二十冬 無相借問
阿舅一下啉酒 就欲攑麥克風
阮查某囝 拜六欲嫁

[Pre-Chorus]
名寫落去 擦掉 閣寫落去
鉛筆賰一寸 天欲光矣

[Chorus]
排桌 排桌
查某囝欲嫁 我先拍一場戰
大姑排第三桌 三姑排第九桌
中央 囥一个耳空重的阿伯

[Verse]
總舖師敲電話 問素食有幾桌
大姑講伊欲坐頭前 三姑講伊嘛欲
我共鉛筆放落 共紅紙捋予平

[Bridge]
「欲冤家 就來我的面頭前冤」

[Chorus]
排桌 排桌
查某囝欲嫁 我先拍一場戰
大姑坐我的倒手 三姑坐我的正手
看恁兩个 敢閣毋講話

[Outro]
拜六 第一桌
三个查某人 笑甲上大聲
